title: Testimonial requests
description: A week after a client pays an invoice in Stripe for a finished piece of work, ask them for a short testimonial about working with the owner

settings.MIN_AMOUNT: invoices under this much (in their currency) don't lead to a request
settings.AFTER_DAYS: days after the payment before asking
settings.ASK_EVERY_DAYS: days before the same client can be asked again
settings.MESSAGE: the request, in the owner's voice; {name} is filled in
settings.SEND: send the request (true) or keep it as a draft for the owner (false)
